Equivalent graphs

Two drawings are equivalent if their edges make the same connections, even if they look different.

Path

A sequence of edges joining distinct vertices, e.g. u1-u5-u2-u3.

Circuit

A closed path that starts and ends at the same vertex.

Degree of a vertex

The number of edges touching that vertex.

Euler path

Uses every edge exactly once, starting and ending at different vertices.

Euler circuit

Uses every edge exactly once and starts and ends at the same vertex.

Theorems and rules

Eulerian Graph Theorem

A connected graph is Eulerian if and only if every vertex has even degree.

Euler Path Theorem

A connected graph has an Euler path if and only if exactly two vertices have odd degree.

Quick check when counting degrees

Each edge touches two vertices, so the degrees always add up to twice the number of edges.
